## Highlights

### 🔧 Runs on .NET 10
The AppImage ships its own .NET runtime. Version 1.2.0 ships .NET 9, which stops receiving security fixes on
November 10, 2026. NMA now ships .NET 10, supported until November 2028.

Nothing changes in how you use the app: your games, loadouts and settings carry over as they are.

## Full changelog

- `chore` migrate to .NET 10: app, tests on Microsoft.Testing.Platform, AppImage packaging with PupNet 1.10.0
- `docs` correct and tighten CLAUDE.md

## Install

Download `NMAcommunity.App.x86_64.AppImage` below, `chmod +x`, run.
